A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes, deploy and forfeit numbers and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-jeroenwebb-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Jeroen Webb (PC Errata 2013 disc card)]] (by 5 May 2013): Same words as the disc card. As a slip it has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip, and the bronze disc is gone. Against the 2013 slip, the stat box reads “POWER 1 ABILITY 2” where the 2013 slip had “POWER 1 ABILITY 2 FORCE-ATTUNED”.

Lower part of the disc card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
